notes.title: Art is Dead is becoming FREE
notes.notes:
Hello everybody!

More than a year after launching Art is Dead, we have decided to stop charging to play the game. We are moving on with other projects, and this was a very small project in the end; we rather have more people playing our game than getting some dollars from it.

To all the people that bought the game previously, we are very thankfull for that, and we hope you enjoyed the game when bought it.

That's all, have a nice weekend!

notes.title: French is here! v1.0.4
notes.notes: Hello everyone! Thanks to the work of Théo Protche we now can bring to our French players a fully translated version of the game. I hope you all enjoy the game!

notes.title: Skin update 1.0.3
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Our team is working hard on our next project, we're hyped to show you something about it! In no time you'll have information about it. We didn't forget about Art is dead, and we fixed some minor bugs in this update. We also added some new skins for those of you who like rewards for getting achievements.

Hope you had nice holidays with family and friends! Talk to all of you soon about our new game!

notes.title: Christmas Update 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Getting ready for the Christmas sale, we have prepared a little update to fix/rework some minor features. We hope you are enjoying the game so far!

[list]
[*]Minor bug fixes
[*]Shotgun bullets decrease
[*]New background and ending sounds
[/list]

notes.title: Ego chamber | Level 4 FIX
notes.notes: Hi everyone! Hope you are enjoying the game. Unfortunately, we found a very big issue with level 4 of the Ego Chamber. Enemies were not spawning. This is fixed, and we encourage you to replay the level if you manage to get there to receive the full experience Ego Chamber offers.
